newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia studies peat generator technology.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia studies peat generator technology.

text.p: Indonesian Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Wednesday his country was studying the construction of small electric generators using peat as a fuel.

"We will study the small scale electricity generators from Denmark. We want generators that do not use oil but, for example, use peat as fuel material," Sudjana told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
Sudjana said he visited Denmark earlier this month to explore opportunities for cooperation with that country to build small scale generators in Indonesia.
"We have a lot of peat in Kalimantan and Sumatra. The peat can be used as the raw material to fuel small generators of around five megawatts (mw)," Sudjana said.
Indonesia has said it needs an additional 25,000 mw over the next 12 years to meet its power needs.
